utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you mean the repair drive? I heard they’re still looking for a few more hands this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: They’re still short a few hands? Are you sure about that?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, that’s what I heard too. They said a few people backed out, so they’re asking around again this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with that repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, what kind of repair drive is it?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s the neighborhood repair drive, just a quick fix-up effort for anyone who needs help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the drive. Just tell me what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’m glad to hear that. I’ll walk you through what needs fixing when I get back from the store.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. I’ll be here when you get back, and we can go through it step by step.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve been hearing about that. I can help if you want to talk through what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, I can go over it with you. I’ve got a running list of what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I’m listening. Walk me through the list and I’ll help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help after school if you need me to, but I have to work around pickup and practice.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would help a lot, thanks. I can keep an eye on the timing if you can take one of the later shifts.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me. I can take the later shift after pickup, as long as I’m done before practice.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Oren. Let’s keep it simple: tell me the plan for the repair drive and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Morning. I’ll load the bins, check the hall light, and then I’ll see who still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. I’ll keep out of your way and check in after you’ve loaded the bins.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure Pia gets the details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, but I’ll need the time and place before I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll ask Pia for the time and place now so I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive coming up, but I’m a little behind on the details. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s happening this Saturday morning at the community center. I can send you the sign-up details and the list of repairs we’re covering.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, send me the sign-up details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I help, can you confirm what part of the repair drive you need me to check?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I need you to check the electrical outlet cluster by the west wall, especially the one that keeps tripping.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it. I’ll check the outlet cluster by the west wall, with extra attention to the one that keeps tripping.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repairs, but I need to keep my own place quiet today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, I can keep it quiet and still help. I’ll join in when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s good enough for me. Keep it quiet, and I’ll be ready when you are.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a drill and a step ladder if that helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That helps a lot. Can you bring them by around two, and do you have the right bits for the drill?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yes, I can bring those by around two, and I’ve got the right drill bits too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive noted. Tell me which lot Bo wants to use, and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Use lot 3 for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, I’ll note lot 3 for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Rey. I’ve got a drill and a ladder you can borrow for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I can use those for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad to help, Rey. Just bring them back when you’re done with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but we need to make sure the timing and supplies are lined up first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm exactly when you think we can start and what supplies are still missing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We can start once the morning delivery arrives, probably around 9, and we still need fasteners, sealant, and one replacement hinge.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that if you tell me what the repair drive still needs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We still need the list of repairs and any materials already on hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I can help pull those together. If you send the repair list and what materials you already have, I’ll organize the rest.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a stock of nails, tarp, and a few extension cords if the drive needs them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good timing — I can use the tarp and cords, and I’ll grab the nails too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll set aside the extension cords too and bring them over when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is picking up, and folks are dropping off supplies after supper. I can tell you who’s organizing the list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can point you to Marla; she’s keeping the sign-up sheet by the church hall.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with that. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Bo. I need you to help organize the volunteer list and check which repair supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll organize the volunteer list and check the supplies. Just send me the current names and what’s already on hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that. Tell me what needs fixing, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure. I just need a drive checked and maybe replaced if it’s bad.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing. I’ll check the drive and let you know if it needs replacing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I heard the repair drive is kicking off soon, Nell, and I’m making sure everyone nearby knows about it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know. I’ll spread the word too, just in case anyone missed it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll keep spreading the word too so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive on my list. Tell me the address and I’ll track it down.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s 214 Maple Street, just two blocks past the bakery. I’ll keep the porch light on so you can spot it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, 214 Maple Street by the bakery. I’ll head there and keep an eye out for that porch light.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What do you need from me about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just the list of materials and the time you can help would be enough.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can do that. Send me the materials list and I’ll let you know when I’m free.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard there’s been a good bit of interest in the repair drive. I can spread the word while I’m out if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be a big help, Ira. I’ll jot down a few spots that need fixing so you can mention them while you’re out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, I’ll mention the main fixes while I’m out.
